446	/// True when the commit prefix `c` names the commit id `id`.
447	fn names(c: &str, id: Option<&String>) -> bool {
448	    id.is_some_and(|id| id.starts_with(c))
449	}

451	/// The report: what is being copied, one fact per line, for the user
452	/// to judge. Nothing in it refuses.
453	pub fn report(f: &Facts) -> Vec<String> {
454	    let mut out = Vec::new();
455	    let Some(r) = &f.reported else {
456	        return out;
457	    };
458	    let mut version = format!("version {}", r.version);
459	    if r.version.contains('-') {
460	        version.push_str(", a suffixed (pre-release) version");
461	    }
462	    if r.version != f.version {
463	        version.push_str(&format!(", the manifest's is {}", f.version));
464	    }
465	    out.push(version);
466	    match &r.commit {
467	        None => {
468	            out.push("commit unknown: the binary reports none".to_string());
469	            out.push("state unknown".to_string());
470	        }
471	        Some(c) => {
472	            let on_trunk = names(c, f.trunk.as_ref());
473	            let on_origin = names(c, f.trunk_origin.as_ref());
474	            let where_ = match (on_trunk, on_origin) {
475	                (true, true) => format!("`{TRUNK}` and `{TRUNK}@origin`"),
476	                (true, false) => format!("`{TRUNK}`, not yet `{TRUNK}@origin`"),
477	                (false, true) => format!("`{TRUNK}@origin`, not the local `{TRUNK}`"),
478	                (false, false) => format!("not `{TRUNK}`"),
479	            };
480	            out.push(format!("commit {c}, {where_}"));
481	            // A commit with no state after it is a clean build.
482	            let state = match &r.state {
483	                Some(s) => s.as_str(),
484	                None => "clean",
485	            };
486	            out.push(format!("state {state}"));
487	        }
488	    }
489	    out
490	}

492	/// Every reason the copy itself would be wrong, empty when it may go,
493	/// `bin_key` the key naming `bin`.
494	pub fn refusals(f: &Facts, bin: &Path, dest: &Path, bin_key: &str) -> Vec<String> {
495	    let mut out = Vec::new();
496	    if !f.bin_exists {
497	        out.push(format!(
498	            "no binary at '{}' after the build: check `{bin_key}`",
499	            bin.display()
500	        ));
501	    } else if f.reported.is_none() {
502	        out.push(format!("'{}' -V could not be run or read", bin.display()));
503	    }
504	    if !f.dest_dir_exists {
505	        // OK: dest is a directory joined with a file name, so it has a parent
506	        let dir = dest.parent().unwrap_or(dest);
507	        out.push(format!(
508	            "the install directory '{}' does not exist",
509	            dir.display()
510	        ));
511	    }
512	    out
513	}

515	/// Copy `bin` to `dest` as a temporary file beside it renamed into
516	/// place, so `dest` is never half written and a running copy of the
517	/// old binary is undisturbed. The temporary file is removed on failure.
518	pub fn deploy(bin: &Path, dest: &Path) -> Result<(), String> {
519	    // OK: dest is a directory joined with a file name, so both exist
520	    let dir = dest.parent().unwrap_or(Path::new("."));
521	    // OK: dest is joined with the binary's file name, so it has one
522	    let name = dest
523	        .file_name()
524	        .map(|n| n.to_string_lossy().into_owned())
525	        .unwrap_or_default();
526	    let tmp = dir.join(format!(".{name}.vc-x1-install"));
527	    let result = std::fs::copy(bin, &tmp)
528	        .map_err(|e| format!("cannot copy to '{}': {e}", tmp.display()))
529	        .and_then(|_| {
530	            std::fs::rename(&tmp, dest).map_err(|e| {
531	                format!(
532	                    "cannot move '{}' into '{}': {e}",
533	                    tmp.display(),
534	                    dest.display()
535	                )
536	            })
537	        });
538	    if result.is_err() {
539	        std::fs::remove_file(&tmp).ok();
540	    }
541	    result
542	}

573	/// Run the build, as `vc-x1 build`, with `--dev` or not, does, then
574	/// report the binary and copy it unless refused or a dry run. Cargo
575	/// rebuilds only what changed, so with nothing changed the binary
576	/// already tested is the one copied.
577	pub fn install(params: &InstallParams) -> Result<(), Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
578	    debug!("{}: entry params={params:?}", params.label);
579	    crate::build_cmd::build(&params.build)?;
580	    let facts = gather(&params.root, &params.bin, &params.dest)
581	        .map_err(|e| format!("{}: {e}", params.label))?;
582	    copy_reported(params, &facts)
583	}

585	/// Print the report, refuse with every reason at once when the copy
586	/// would be wrong, then, unless it is a dry run, run the install list
587	/// when there is one, else copy the binary to its destination.
588	pub fn copy_reported(
589	    params: &InstallParams,
590	    facts: &Facts,
591	) -> Result<(), Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
592	    let (label, bin, dest) = (params.label, &params.bin, &params.dest);
593	    match &params.list {
594	        Some(_) => info!("{label}: '{}' -> list `{}`", bin.display(), params.list_key),
595	        None => info!("{label}: '{}' -> '{}'", bin.display(), dest.display()),
596	    }
597	    for line in report(facts) {
598	        info!("{label}:   {line}");
599	    }
600	    let reasons = refusals(facts, bin, dest, params.bin_key);
601	    if !reasons.is_empty() {
602	        let list: String = reasons.iter().map(|r| format!("\n  - {r}")).collect();
603	        return Err(format!(
604	            "{label}: refused, nothing copied to '{}':{list}",
605	            dest.display()
606	        )
607	        .into());
608	    }
609	    if params.dry_run {
610	        match &params.list {
611	            Some(_) => info!("{label}: [dry-run] ran nothing of `{}`", params.list_key),
612	            None => info!("{label}: [dry-run] copied nothing"),
613	        }
614	        return Ok(());
615	    }
616	    if let Some(list) = &params.list {
617	        return run_list(params, list);
618	    }
619	    deploy(bin, dest).map_err(|e| format!("{label}: {e}"))?;
620	    info!("{label}: copied");
621	    Ok(())
622	}

624	/// Run the install list from the root, in place of the copy, its
625	/// placeholders the binary and the directory, resolved for the run.
626	fn run_list(params: &InstallParams, list: &[String]) -> Result<(), Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
627	    let bin = params.bin.to_string_lossy();
628	    // OK: dest is a directory joined with a file name, so it has a parent
629	    let dir = params
630	        .dest
631	        .parent()
632	        .unwrap_or(&params.dest)
633	        .to_string_lossy();
634	    let mut vars = vec![
635	        (params.names[0], bin.as_ref()),
636	        (params.names[1], dir.as_ref()),
637	    ];
638	    if let Some(name) = params.names.get(2) {
639	        vars.push((name, params.suffix.as_str()));
640	    }
641	    crate::command_list::run(
642	        &params.root,
643	        params.list_key,
644	        list,
645	        &[],
646	        &vars,
647	        params.label,
648	    )
649	}

- dev [[17]], the dev install mid-cycle, into `~/.cargo/bin/vc-x1-dev`
- dev-dir [[15]], where it goes
- dev-suffix [[18]], what the dev build's file name gets, so it sits beside the release and never
  replaces it
- dir [[23]] and commands [[24]], the install for every profile, into `~/.cargo/bin` under the
  binary's name with the chosen profile's suffix, replacing the five keys above once `--profile`
  lands
```toml

dir = "~/.cargo/bin"
commands = [
  "cp {profile.bin} {install.dir}/vc-x1{profile.suffix}.new",
  "mv {install.dir}/vc-x1{profile.suffix}.new {install.dir}/vc-x1{profile.suffix}",
]
release = [
  "cp {build.release-bin} {install.release-dir}/vc-x1.new",
  "mv {install.release-dir}/vc-x1.new {install.release-dir}/vc-x1",
]
release-dir = "~/.cargo/bin"
dev = [
  "cp {build.dev-bin} {install.dev-dir}/vc-x1{install.dev-suffix}.new",
  "mv {install.dev-dir}/vc-x1{install.dev-suffix}.new {install.dev-dir}/vc-x1{install.dev-suffix}",
]
dev-dir = "~/.cargo/bin"
dev-suffix = "-dev"
```

input.message:
`vc-x1 build`, `run` and `install` now choose their build by `--profile NAME`. The `--dev` flag and the fixed release/dev split are gone. `cargo fmt` and `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` are clean, and `cargo test -- --include-ignored` passes 891 tests with 0 failing (812 unit tests plus 79 integration tests).

I ran the binary on this workspace's real config, without `install` and without building:
- `build --dry-run` prints `build: profile release` and then `cargo build --profile release --locked`.
- `build --profile nope` is refused naming the config file and "the profiles defined are: dev, release".
- `run --dev` and `run-dev` are refused naming `run --profile dev`.

**Files changed:** `src/build_cmd.rs`, `src/install_cmd.rs`, `src/run_cmd.rs`, `src/command_list.rs`, `src/main.rs` (help text), plus `src/validate.rs` (new call signature and module docs) and `src/version.rs` (one doc line). The diff also shows `Cargo.toml` (version to `0.85.15-3`), `Cargo.lock` and `zDOING.md` (rung marked current). Those edits were not mine. I believe they are your opening steps.

**Public API added or changed:**
- `build_cmd`:
  - `pub struct Profile { pub name: String, pub vars: Vec<(String, String)>, pub lists: Vec<(String, Vec<String>)>, pub bin: PathBuf, pub suffix: String }`, with `var_refs()`, `list_refs()` and `names() -> (Vec<&str>, Vec<&str>)`.
  - `pub fn resolve_profile(root: &Path, requested: Option<&str>, label: &str) -> Result<Profile, String>`
  - `pub fn defined_profiles(map: &HashMap<String, String>) -> Vec<String>` returns the names sorted, without duplicates.
  - `pub fn build_params(profile: Option<&str>, repo: Option<&Path>) -> Result<BuildParams, String>`
  - `pub fn retired_dev_flag(command: &str) -> String` produces the exact `--dev` refusal you specified. `retired_dev` now names `<command> --profile dev`.
  - `pub const BUILD_COMMANDS_KEY`.
  - `BuildParams` loses `bin` and gains `profile: Profile`.
  - `release_bin`, `dev_bin` and `bin_at` were removed.
- `command_list`:
  - `run(root, key, commands, env, vars, lists, label)` and `run_one(root, command, env, vars, lists, label)` now fill through `expand`.
  - `check_placeholders(commands, names, list_names, key, label)` takes the list names as a new parameter.
  - The public `words` was removed because nothing outside the tests used it; it remains as a test-only helper.
- `install_cmd`:
  - `install_params(profile: Option<&str>, repo, dir, dry_run)`.
  - `InstallParams` now has `bin_key: String`, `list_key` set to `"install.commands"`, and owned `vars` and `lists` (which include `install.dir`). The `suffix` and `names` fields are gone.
  - `dev_suffix`, `guard_release` and `same_place` were replaced by `guard_others`.
